name: Purification Through Blood
body:
School transmutation [blood]; Level bloodlord 4, shaman 4, witch 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (your blood, see text)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Fortitude (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

You cut your palm and touch the target with your bloody hand. The blood then attempts to cleanse the target of impurities. This spell functions as lesser restoration, remove disease, and neutralize poison except that you take damage based on what you heal or grant a chance to thwart. You take 2d10 damage when attempting to cure a poison or disease or 1d10 damage when removing fatigue or 1d10 per ability score healed (maximum 4). You may choose to cure between 1 and 4 ability score damage when touching the target instead of rolling 1d4. You may also do all or some of the curative effects, taking the damage for each component. However, the disease and poison removal is not guaranteed as per those spells. The damage accrued when casting this spell cannot be mitigated or prevented, but can be healed normally.
